veranderings.blok: Die sleutel sê wat die simbole beteken
veranderings.voor: sê nie altyd uit sy eie wat hy beteken nie
veranderings.na: sê nie altyd self wat hy beteken nie
veranderings.rede: 'Uit sy eie' means 'of its own accord' and reads like a calque of 'on its own'; 'self' is the natural Afrikaans here (net -2 words).
After an instruction ('Lees eers die sleutel'), 'dan' expresses the result that follows; 'nou' wrongly suggests the reader already did it (net 0 words).
The next sentence says 'of jy reg geraai het', so switching from 'n mens to jy within two sentences is inconsistent; using jy throughout keeps the reference steady (net -1 word).

veranderings.voor: Iemand anders kan jou kaart makliker lees as jou simbole in 'n sleutel staan.
veranderings.na: As jou simbole in 'n sleutel staan, kan iemand anders jou kaart makliker lees.
veranderings.rede: 'Makliker lees as' first reads as a comparison ('easier than your symbols'); putting the conditional clause first removes the ambiguity without changing the meaning (net 0 words).
